pages.title: About KAMPUS
pages.seoDescription: Learn how KAMPUS unifies 21 student workflows into one connected academic platform.

blocks.title: Built Around the Real Student Journey

blocks.body: KAMPUS brings together coursework materials, AI academic guidance, peer study rooms, official campus circulars, career opportunities, and verified student identity passes inside a single cohesive workspace.

items.title: Academic Mastery
items.detail: Study Hub, KAMPUS AI, Notes Exchange, and Smart Planner.

items.title: Connected Campuses
items.detail: Campus Pulse, Events & Clubs, KAMPUS ID, and Student Voice.

items.title: Verified Trust
items.detail: Encrypted Digital Locker and role-governed data privacy.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.seoDescription: How KAMPUS protects student identity records, private Digital Locker files, and academic telemetry.

blocks.body: Private files stored inside Digital Locker remain strictly isolated to your authenticated student account and are never exposed in administrative bulk exports.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.seoDescription: Community guidelines, academic integrity standards, and campus marketplace rules on KAMPUS.

blocks.body: Students must uphold university honour codes when uploading notes, participating in SkillSwap, or listing items on KAMPUS Market.

pages.title: Help & Student Support
pages.seoDescription: Frequently asked questions and support resources for KAMPUS modules.

items.title: How do I verify my student account?
items.detail: Open KAMPUS ID or Onboarding to submit your enrollment ID for institutional verification.

items.title: Are my Digital Locker files private?
items.detail: Yes. Only files for which you explicitly generate a timed share link can be viewed externally.

pages.title: Contact KAMPUS
pages.seoDescription: Reach KAMPUS campus coordinators and platform support.

blocks.body: Reach our support team via support@kampus.edu.in or submit an issue ticket from Account > Settings > Help & Support.
